scope: offline adapter library and synthetic processes; production runtime remains disabled

framing.oversize: discard through LF, emit counted placeholder, continue; never infer a lost response or settlement

limits.displayOverflow: explicit bounded placeholder/truncation, not session failure
limits.unknownOrImageContent: counted placeholder, never decoded as text

launchFlagReference.verification: passive reads of this installed package version in package.json and its bundled documentation; no Pi invocation
launchFlagReference.noApprove: Ignores trust-gated project-local configuration and resources for this process.
launchFlagReference.offline: Disables automatic network activity, including model catalog refreshes. Equivalent to PI_OFFLINE=1.
launchFlagReference.securityBoundary: Pi does not ask for approval before every tool call; project trust does not restrict tool authority. --offline is not a network sandbox or a guarantee of zero model calls.

resume: same private native session ID and same private session directory; never --continue, no automatic prompt replay
startup: explicit get_state confirms matching native session identity and an idle process; this does not substitute for agent_settled after a run
readiness: a prompt response is acceptance only; agent_end is not idle; only agent_settled ends observed run activity

approvals.selectInputEditor: waiting_for_local_ui; no guessed value or fabricated tool policy

secrets: never forward get_state sessionId/sessionFile, stderr, raw RPC error strings or extension paths to shared observations
realSmoke: requires explicit local-owner authorization; never run by default CI; remains required before M1-4 acceptance
